_comment: The marketplaces kept full and moving in the simulated players' names (Managers.MarketMaker),
a tick a minute, while the simulated players are on (config SimulatedPlayers).
enabled           false: the marketplaces are left to the bots walking to the counters
itemsPerHouse     how many different items each marketplace should have on sale
listPerTick       the most items put on sale in one marketplace a minute while it fills
botLotMinutes     a bot's lot is bought, on average, after this many minutes
playerLotMinutes  YOUR lot at a fair price is bought, on average, after this many minutes
(twice as fast under 80% of its worth)
fairPercent       the dearest your lot may be, against its worth, and still be bought
Worths: Managers.ReferencePrices, and content/market/reference_prices.json by hand.
houses            marketplaces kept: resources 1261, consumables 1263, equipment 1262, runes
1264, creatures 1265. One book for the whole world: Bonta's, Brakmar's and
Astrub's counters of a kind are the same marketplace, so all are filled.
exoPercent        % of equipment put on sale that is an exo: +1 AP (x25 price), +1 MP (x12)
or +1 range (x6) its template does not give
perfectPercent    % of equipment put on sale with every characteristic at its best (x2)
